builds.howItPlays: You play cheap units that leave a Bird token or Gold behind when they die, then back them with 4-cost Champions and strap Hextech Gauntlets (+3 Might, and cheaper to attach to a bigger unit) onto whichever one is attacking. Kennen, Keeper of Balance stuns a blocker so it deals no combat damage, and when you conquer with 3 or more damage to spare, you can exhaust Vi to ready that unit and attack again.
builds.whyYou: You like a steady board that trades well, and you don't mind losing a small unit when it leaves something useful behind. You enjoy the math of each attack: which unit gets the Gauntlets, whether Kennen should stun the blocker first, and whether you can clear 3 extra damage to send the same unit in again. Games reach the middle turns and turn on a few big fights, not on a lucky draw. If sizing up a fight and then winning it by more than you needed sounds fun, Vi suits you.
builds.ratingNotes:
Change 2026-09-25: relabelled Tempo to Midrange, following the Maintainer's picks (all three raters labelled it Midrange). The scorer's suggestion was Aggro on every sheet, since final Pace and Stance are both 6.5. The rater chose Midrange because the expensive cards stop at 4-cost Champions and the deck builds up gear over several turns. Coordinates moved from 7/7.5/6.5/5.5 to 6.5/6.5/6/4.5 (Pace -0.5, Stance -1, Complexity -0.5, Variance -1). The old numbers came from guide quotes, not scored decks. deckListUrl moved from the bare /decks page to the style's display deck. The riftboundguide.com (2026-04-08 champion deck guide) and hextechanalytics links were removed because neither was confirmed to describe the current list.
Scored decks (pace/stance/complexity/variance): Vi Beatdown Vendetta Style (RiftRunner91; post-ban) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/80f6c113-c6bc-4501-abe9-b4681cb0b862 6.5/6.5/6/4.5 Midrange. Regional Qualifier Singapore Best of Vi (Haru; pre-ban, x0.75) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/2a7690a9-9a9a-4d6d-8f3e-b671c7733305 6.5/6.5/6/4.5 Midrange. Best of Vi Barcelona (CC ImboSlice; pre-ban, x0.75) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/350c1cf6-b1cd-4d23-b6fe-a23935f1a647 6.5/6.5/6/4.5 Midrange. Mean 6.5/6.5/6/4.5.
Adjustments (all three sheets): complexity +0.5. The Legend readies a unit after a conquer with 3+ excess damage, so attacks have to be sized and ordered to trigger it. On the Barcelona list this also covers Forge of the Fluft moving Equipment. Formula and judgment were never 2 or more apart.
Deciding cards: Pace comes from 8 to 9 two-cost units (Unsung Hero, Carrion Dredger, Honest Broker) and a band of 4-cost Champions (Kai'Sa, Survivor; Fiora, Victorious; Jhin, Murderous Artist; Rengar, Unseen), with only 1 to 3 cards at 5+ (Vi, Peacekeeper; Ashe, Focused; Brynhir Thundersong; Ferrous Forerunner). Stance comes from about 16 to 17 pressure units against Hidden Blade, Kennen, Keeper of Balance, Falling Star and Tactical Retreat. Complexity comes from Hextech Gauntlets' equip cost dropping by the chosen unit's Might, Deathgrip and Deathknell sequencing, Hidden cards, and the Legend's excess-damage ready. Variance is low because the lists run full playsets and draw off conquers (Kai'Sa, Hextech Gauntlets) and deaths (Unsung Hero, Deathgrip).
Legend ability: when you conquer, if you assigned 3 or more excess damage, you may exhaust Vi to ready a unit.
Also played: Inferna Swarm Vi (cheap Ambush and Assault units with Ganking; all pre-ban) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/e0c97ee7-c20b-47ba-9a9a-e977b31f3716 (Aggro 6.5/7.5/5.5/5), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/1db45d40-5be7-4d79-b2b1-d42afa8af99e (Ottawa Showdown Best of, Aggro 6.5/7/6/5), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/88033663-9cdf-4259-b528-df52a29def8b (Jureim, guide and matchups, Aggro 6.5/6.5/6/4.5). Kayle Destructive Vi (Vi, Destructive in the Champion zone, gear stacked on one Mighty Ganking threat) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/b6d283bd-a782-4519-bd72-11a138368433 (sirfenixthecrazy, 51 likes, guide, Midrange 6/6.5/7/5.5), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/f736d55f-156b-4219-8600-ddc891edac35 (Dea GhostWithKnife, guide, pre-ban, Midrange 6/7/6.5/5.5). Miracle Vi (trades units and Gold for cards, then finishes with cheap Battering Rams; a brew) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/3f58ab63-a585-4bf6-8a43-9f1076391dd8 (Alvin Hsu, guide, pre-ban, Midrange 5.5/6/7/5.5). Vi CCS Houston (ShenYod@ VI 4.6) was merged into this style by the curator and runs the same Kennen, Kai'Sa and Gauntlets plan.
Confidence: medium.
Reviewer check: only one of the three scored decks is post-ban, and no post-ban tournament lists existed as of 2026-09-25 (the Los Angeles RQ runs 2026-09-25 to 27), so re-check against LA results. guideUrls are the three scored deck pages only; no written guide for this exact list was fetched.
